correctness.evidence: Fresh enumeration of all 1024 complementary-pair transversals and S6 canonicalization reproduced exactly 13 classes and the stated orbit sizes.

originality.evidence: Polcyn-Rucinski 2017, published p.601 and Proposition 1.6, explicitly gives the same 2^10 six-vertex systems and 13 non-isomorphic classes.

value.evidence: After subtracting prior coverage, only routine certificate-level invariants remain, with no meaningful new theorem, regime, or method.
